scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint -- --fix -w api && npm run lint -- --fix -w web
scripts.test: npm run test -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test -- --coverage -w api && npm run test -- --coverage -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test
scripts.clean: rimraf apps/*/dist apps/*/.next apps/*/coverage apps/*/out node_modules/.cache coverage .next
